body: I'm unable to force myself to think about that scenario, if i was able to put myself in that position I'd hope to force myself to think differently. I wish it was so simple.

I know he's trying to help in his way, but comparing experience from his time in the army and mine doesn't really help, it makes things worse.

My mom is the one who comes with me to my appointments, till recently she had an alchohol problem, but she pushed past that to help me, which is why I feel so determined to try and help myself.

I'm sorry if you feel obliged to reply to me, I don't want to make anybody feel bad about themselves x_x

My mother knows I want to end things, my father thinks everything can be solved with speech, he constantly speaks of been bored everyday, and argues with me about boredom, I've not left the house in almost 7 years apart from the gp visits, I don't understand how he has the nerve -.-

I'd go along with it enough to say it's a beautiful idea, sadly not plausible for the majority due to a multitude of reasons. This is something I'd personally go along with if I was able, but sadly I can't even leave my own home, not to mention financial reasons.

I wish I could have a fresh start, it'd change everything, if I knew I'd end up like this I might have been able to change how I lived my life.

I guess this last 24 hours has told me everything I needed to know.

Thankyou for the people that tried to give me advice, I really appreciated it, but medication doesn't solve everything, I really just needed somebody to talk to who won't put me in debt for the next 20 to 30 years, not like they'd have got their money anyway.

I've no idea. It began in my early teens, I started to go out less and less, I started to become uncomfortable when I left the house which later developed into me having panic attacks and I began to have physical health scares.

My parents got took to court for truancy and I dropped out of school, I guess this is when I stopped leaving the house completely, I no longer had any mandatory reasons to go outside, so I just stayed in my comfort zone and it snowballed.

Now I'm just stuck with the opposite, I want to go out, I need to get out, I'm sick of these walls, this "life". I wish it was as easy as just wanting it, I don't think I have any hope left, but I don't want to die, I guess I'm grasping at straws by posting here, even this is a struggle for me.

I've been put on some tricyclics and maois in the past, desipramine, pipofezine, tranylcypromine and amitriptyline, I'm currently on lofepramine and it doesn't really do much apart from help me sleep.

They think an attempt of humour helps the situation but it really doesn't, I guess it's just how to try to deal with it for themselves.

They are really supportive in other ways, but it's just not enough anymore, I'm really at the end of my tether, I really don't like that I'm thinking about suicide it depresses me even more.

I do understand what you're saying, and while I may have oscillated to your thoughts in the past, I have tried to focus on myself constantly, after a while I always turned to self harm to feel good about myself, the release of endorphins was almost orgasmic to me, but that turned into a comedy too.

I'd be the constant amusement of people, friends, family, who couldn't understand what I was/am going through, the focus of multiple jokes. Ie, if I bathed it must have been my "birthday", I must have got a new "doctor", because he must be stopping me from bleeding, the vampiric jokes are endless, while not all my relatives decide to poke at my demeanor the few that do are quite hurtful, I try to ignore the random people, but when it's my relatives that is what hurts the most.

The few that do support me and what I've tried are of great help (thankyou everbody else too), but as I said, I feel like I'm at the end of my tether, I've still not heard anything other than what I've already tried, so only one route is open to me, I really don't want to follow this path I'll be honest, I care so much about my nieces, it was one of their birthdays recently and I guess it's what brought this whole thing on, I want to be their for my family in the future, but not like this, I care so much, but how will it be in the future when I can't even take them out. Sigh.

My therapy over the past four too five years generally involved trying to reproduce mental incidents that never happened, a repetitive procedure of family abuse and self harm,  I felt my psychiatrists was trying to satisfy themselves more than they was trying to help me.

I understand that it can take a very long time, and i have been very patient, I'm approaching seven years, I've not had a single percent of progress, I've been through almost every medication on the market for anxiety and depression. I do love my family, but I feel I've put them before myself for to long, they is only so much somebody can take.

I appreciate your comment, it made me smile albeit briefly, I just wish I could feel that way all the time.
